title: Most news apps are designed to keep you scrolling, not to help you understand.
body:
We built Deep Dive Mode at Headlinne to change that dynamic. When you see a story that matters, you often need more than just the latest update. You need context. You need to know how we got here.

Deep Dive Mode uses AI to surface the essential background information behind the headlines. It connects the dots on complex topics without forcing you to open ten different browser tabs or search for old articles yourself. It turns a quick update into a complete picture.

Our goal isn't to flood you with more content. It is to help you get the most out of the time you spend reading. When you understand the story, you can form your own opinion instead of just reacting to the noise.
cta: See how it works for yourself at HEADLINNE.com.
